games.name: Dungeons and Dragons
games.description: The Grandaddy of RPGs, this game has been around the block and is currently on the 5th (and a half) edition.

games.name: Pathfinder
games.description: Pathfinder is a fantasy tabletop roleplaying game where you tell heroic tales in a world of quests, magic, monsters, and treasures. Your choices, and the roll of the dice, determine how the story unfolds.

games.name: Gamma World
games.description: Gamma World is a post-apocalyptic science fantasy role-playing game where players explore a devastated Earth, encountering mutated creatures and ancient technology.

games.name: Malifaux
games.description: Malifaux is a miniatures skirmish game where players take control of a crew led by a master and fight to achieve their hidden schemes and other goals. Manipulate fate using the cards dealt to you and rise to power on the bloody streets of Malifaux City!

games.name: Bushido
games.description: Bushido is a fantasy tabletop miniatures skirmish game for two players, set in the fictional Jwar Isles.The Jwar Isles are inspired by the mythologies of East and South East Asia; most notably, but not limited to, Japan.

games.name: DnD Minitatures Chainmail
games.description: Set in the world of Greyhawk, 6 factions fight over the relics of a dead god.

games.name: Warhammer Old World
games.description: Set in a European like world, in the late medieval ages.

games.name: Kill Team
games.description: Grimdark setting in the far future. Humanity is in perpetual war.

games.name: Settler of Catan
games.description: Picture yourself in the era of discoveries: after a long voyage of great deprivation, your ships have finally reached the coast of an uncharted island. Its name shall be Catan!

games.name: Malediction
games.description: Malediction is the world's first 3D-printable Miniature Card Game.
